Democrats are suing the Trump administration over its last-minute changes to forms used

American citizens from voting.
In a federal lawsuit, the Democratic National Committee argues the Trump administration
did not follow the proper procedure when it changed two absentee voting forms for overseas
U.S. citizens.

The Pentagon says it now believes those overseas citizens are not eligible to use its forms,
but state election officials can continue processing older versions of the forms.
Meanwhile, the Republican National Committee has sued more than a handful of states for

Hansi Lo Wang, NPR News.
You're listening to NPR News from Washington.
